machineScope.reason: Rule 113: one root's tool working state on this machine, never shared or resumed elsewhere. Each conversation keeps one fixed-size volume (128 MB; at most 4 conversations per root, a further one's turns run in a fresh one-turn volume removed after the turn), mounted only during a turn; its files persist for later turns of that conversation and are never deleted to make room. Its kept harness session (MF5) is a cache of the journal: the runner's session record beside the volume and the harness transcript in the login profile's projects directory, rotated (old transcript removed) whenever the authority, harness, model or a journal fact changes, at 6 turns or 512 KiB, on a compaction, a loss or an interrupted turn, and ended (removed) at a stop, withdrawal or failed turn. Only the newest 16 turn directories (the admission hook's config, call and subagent slots, record, and the copy of the root's MCP launch configuration) are kept; the journal's tool-turn rows are the durable record. On failover nothing moves: the new machine's turns start a new workspace and session from the journal.

agreesWith.invariant: a kept harness session is resumed only while its recorded journal-facts digest, tools authority, harness and model equal the current ones; any difference, a loss or an unclean turn starts a new session grounded from the journal, and every turn's input is the current journal packet
